outcome: Give eCommerce teams a working Semantic Product Search & Conversational Shopping Assistant capability on their own data — it drives higher search-to-cart conversion and lower bounce.
overview: Shoppers describe what they want in their own words, while keyword search matches tokens — so a large share of natural-language queries return nothing useful. Those sessions end in a silent exit rather than a support ticket, which is why the lost revenue rarely appears in any report. Semantic Product Search & Conversational Shopping Assistant embeds the catalogue as vectors and places a language-model orchestrator in front of it, so intent-led and conversational queries return genuinely relevant products. Answers stay grounded in the customer’s own catalogue and stock. Redington baselines search-to-cart conversion and query abandonment, then delivers the working assistant on real catalogue and search-log data in four to five weeks.
